contribution: prospective conditional-error prediction on unseen dependency classes

cost.preference: fastest completion; report real utilization without padding

estimands.primary: mean KL(dependence-only hash tie) minus KL(predicted choice), all 6 lineages x10 classes x8 prompts x3 positions
estimands.uncertainty: 10000 percentile bootstrap replicates; sample 6 lineages and10 classes with replacement independently; within each sampled class sample8 prompt indices, retaining all3 positions; shared prompt resample across lineages

interpretation.lineage: fresh task-training lineages sharing public pretrained backbone; no seed71 descendants
interpretation.transfer: empirical source-to-target hypothesis, no finite context-density bound across disjoint classes

predictor.commitment: all six model prediction artifacts plus hashes sealed before any held-out neural evaluation
predictor.fallback: if any feature in either policy unsupported, choose dependence-only content-hash tie
predictor.method: source-only per-output bin means with pooled-round-and-position shrinkage

retention.checkpoint: step3100 for every seed, no quality selection or retries for poor learning
retention.missing_lineage: report incomplete result, no full-study success claim; no imputed finite KL
retention.negative_result: retain failed gates and all policy scores, do not redefine task, panel or predictor
retention.operational_failure: retain failed attempt and cost; manual identical scientific-source repair only, never automatic restart

success_gates.calibration_added_value: report gain over fanin heuristic and source-unconditional baseline; positive transfer alone does not prove calibration needed
success_gates.competence: mean selected-policy held-out KL below4log2, averaged over all declared classes/prompts/positions

training.initialization: public pretrained backbone; independent conditioning initialization and data seeds
